results.description:
75X — Transform Your Discipline

Unlock bulletproof mental toughness, build a warrior physique, and lock in healthy daily routines with the ultimate 75-day challenge companion.

75X is not just a habit tracker — it is a gamified, self-transformation system designed to help you execute the rules of the legendary 75-day mental grit challenge, stay accountable, and build raw discipline. 

Whether you want to follow the strict Hard Mode rules, run a Standard routine, or customize your own habit challenges, 75X provides the clean visual blueprints, daily reminders, and gamified progress tracking you need to succeed where most people quit.


KEY FEATURES:

1. Choose Your Challenge Mode:
• Hard Mode (Core 75 Hard rules): Two 45-minute workouts (one outdoors), 1 gallon of water, strict diet (no cheats/alcohol), daily progress photo, and 10 pages of reading.
• Standard Mode: Fully tailored workouts and water goals based on your personal fitness baseline.
• Custom Mode: Handpick and build your own custom checklist from our master list of habits and wellness tasks.

2. Extra Challenge Add-ons:
Level up your program by adding custom challenges to your checklist:
• Cold Showers (5-minute grit builder)
• Daily Meditation (silent awareness)
• Digital Detox (no social media scrolling)
• No Refined Sugar (clean eating booster)
• Prayer & Spiritual Connection
• Retention & energy focus

3. Gamified RPG Progression:
Track your transformation with RPG-style stats. Earn XP (Experience Points) and boost your personal attributes as you complete tasks:
• Attributes: Track changes in your Discipline, Strength, Focus, Wisdom, Energy, and Confidence.
• Power Score: Get a live, dynamic score representing your overall consistency.
• Rank Progression: Climb from a Recruit to a Warrior, Elite, Legend, and finally a Master on Day 75.

4. Progress Photo Log:
Take and log daily progress pictures to visualize your physical transformation day by day. Keep your visual progress securely formatted in one chronological timeline.

5. Lock-In Daily Reminders:
Choose your preferred wake-up and reminder times. Get intelligent, daily check-in notifications to complete your tasks before midnight.

6. Social Feed & Community Support:
You don't have to walk the path alone. Post your milestones, share your achievements, and like or comment on other warriors' posts in our curated community feed.


UPGRADE TO 75X PRO:
Supercharge your challenge with 75X Pro. Gain access to advanced features:
• AI Discipline Coach: Get tailored coaching tips and personalized guidance to stay motivated.
• Custom Challenge Logs: Create and customize unlimited checkboxes in your routine.
• Visual Photo Analysis: Analyze and track physical changes in your progress photos.


SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:

75X offers auto-renewing subscription options to access 75X Pro premium features:
• Weekly Plan: $3.99 per week
• Yearly Plan: $29.99 per year (includes a free trial if offered, billed annually)

*Pricing may vary by location.*

• Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, at the rate of the selected plan.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
